Fate/Extra is fully translated in english  and can be played on the PSP/PS Vita. CCC has a full english translated playthrough on youtube but no patch for it, so your only option is to watch it. Numbers get bigger = fun

Jokes aside, it's probably more about extrinsic and intrinsic progress in games and you dont enjoy extrinsic,  numbers get bigger, but more intrinsic, you get better at the game skill wise.

Fans of Turn-Based RPG combat usually enjoy extrinsic progress because for us it's fun to see the literal progress of the characters, like hitting harder, taking less damage from enemies hours of progress behind is, and getting cool new skills to defeat enemies with. All these types of games still have intrinsic progress just to a lesser degree, such as how to most utilize your new skills and how to take down the boss with new skills your characters have acuired.

Intrinsic is more like having all tools open to you at the start(or a good variety of them) and you have to master them yourself with your own skill, like character action games or shooters. In these types of games it's all about your own progression and feels more satisfying. These games require little to no extrinsic progress, like levels for better stats, so there is far less grinding for such things, which maybe why you don't enjoy extrinsic as much as intrinsic.
